evals.prompt: Scaffold a new Expo TypeScript app with a bottom tab navigator containing Home, Profile, and Settings screens.
evals.expected_output: The agent creates the Expo project, installs React Navigation, and implements a Tab.Navigator with three screens.

evals.prompt: Integrate push notifications into an Expo app and register the device token, handling simulator and permission-denied cases.
evals.expected_output: The agent implements the permission request flow, returns null for simulators and denied permissions, and stores the token securely.
expectations: Returns null on denied permission instead of throwing
Token stored via expo-secure-store, not plain AsyncStorage
